description: This file is a Java Spring REST controller class ('ShelfController') managing CRUD operations for book shelves in a book-tracking application. It handles fetching, creating, renaming, and deleting user-defined shelves, interfacing with service layers and returning appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: ShelfController
classes.description: A REST controller for managing book shelves, allowing fetching all shelves, creating new shelves, renaming existing shelves, and deleting shelves for the logged-in user.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all shelves (predefined and user-created) for the logged-in user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user-defined shelf with the specified name.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to rename an existing user-created shelf.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a user-created shelf.
